command:
git add tests && git commit -m "fix: keep the Codex family CI checks current with the confined runner (APRV-325.3)

CI caught two of my own assertions going stale.

\`tests/codex-package.test.ts\` still expected \`codex start\` to refuse
codex-not-ready. It now validates the manifest before it asks the host about a
sandbox, so a bad manifest is a manifest error and never a confinement verdict;
\`start\` joins the list of verbs asserted to refuse an unvalidatable manifest.

Three \`tests/codex-confine.test.ts\` cases read a prepared session and so looked
pure. Preparing one needs a working mechanism, and on a host without one the
runner refuses by design, so they stand down with the rest of the spawning cases
rather than asserting against a refusal they were not written for.
